records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Logistics
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Getting your first Wrenfield project started
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

I know I've already landed in your inbox once or twice, so I'll keep this short. Nothing has been set up in your Wrenfield workspace yet, and that's an easy thing to fix.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the fastest way to see how it fits your work at Vantage Logistics. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it yourself.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
